lead_raw_text:
The structure of Na4Mg2Si2 (reduced formula Na2MgSi) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 32 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg centers with 12 geometric neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Na centers exhibit 10- and 13-neighbor environments; Si centers are tetrahedrally coordinated by four Na neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Si tetrahedra and corner- or edge-sharing between Mg 12-vertex polyhedra and Si tetrahedra.
